<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> PrincipalsSyncedData:
    application_code: <span class="hl-type">str</span>
    created: <span class="hl-type">int</span>
    deactivated: <span class="hl-type">int</span>
    synced_emails: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>]
    updated: <span class="hl-type">int</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; PrincipalsSyncedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            application_code=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;applicationCode&quot;</span>),
            created=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;created&quot;</span>),
            deactivated=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;deactivated&quot;</span>),
            synced_emails=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;syncedEmails&quot;</span>),
            updated=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;updated&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;applicationCode&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.application_code,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;created&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.created,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;deactivated&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.deactivated,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;syncedEmails&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.synced_emails,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;updated&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.updated,
        }
